title: 3BR Loft | Walk to Broadway Downtown | Pool Gym |
description:
Welcome to one of the best locations to all the downtown attractions! Only 3 blocks to Lower Broadway! You can't beat this location and you'll love the luxurious pool & two story gym during your stay. Walk to all the Honky Tonks, Live Music, Bars, Restaurants, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, The Music City Center, Ryman Auditorium, The Convention Center, Printer's Alley, The Gulch, and much more!

Permit #2018075009

The space
This 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom apartment sleeps 8! Enjoy the Gourmet Kitchen, In-unit washer and dryer, and luxury building amenities. Building amenities and common areas are shared with other guests.

3 BEDROOMS & 3 ATTACHED BATHROOMS:
Bedroom #1: one King bed
Bedroom #2: one King bed
Loft #3: one King bed
*All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms

LIVING ROOM:
Sofa bed (queen size) and a Smart TV. Right off the living room there is a private access to Peabody St. Just a few steps away from Starbucks.

KITCHEN:
The gourmet kitchen has stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a large island with 4 stools. Stocked with dishware and cooking utensils. Coffee bar with Keurig and K-Cups. Off of the kitchen is a small dining table with 4 chairs.

LUXURY AMENITIES INCLUDED:
★ Outdoor pool (heated)
★ 2 level fitness center & yoga studio
★ Climbing wall, treadmills, spin bikes
★ Sky lounge with deck & city views
★ The Collective: 2 story hangout & work
★ Fire pits, grills
★ Courtyard Hangout Area
★ On-site Maintenance
★ On-Site Concierge & Security
★ Washer and Dryer with detergent
★ Keurig and K-Cups
★ Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash

PARKING OPTIONS:

1. There is ONLY ONE Reserved Gated Parking Space available for $30 per night. This is a specific assigned parking space with # listed on the Parking Tag. Guests must tell host and make these arrangements in before check-in day.

2. Additional Parking - Guest Parking has 15 spaces and open to the public - first come/first served. Pay daily be parking meter. Prices vary depending on demand ($20-40/night). Nashville also has many parking lots in the city and within walking distance to the apartment complex.

Guest access
Guests will have entire apartment to themselves and access to all luxury building amenities. Building amenities/common spaces are shared with other guests in the building.

Other things to note
Absolutely no smoking or vaping allowed inside apartment or outside on balcony, common areas, or parking garage. Any EVIDENCE OR SMELL will result in a $500 fine - NO exceptions! You will be fined! Please do not book our place if you plan to smoke or vape. Thank you for understanding.

You’re staying in an AirBnB, not a hotel. Please treat our home like you'd treat your own. There will be no one assisting you upon arrival like a hotel so reading the detailed instructions before arrival is very important for a seamless stay at our place. Self check-in is also with the Latch App on your smartphone. There are no key cards.

Potential for noise from both neighbors inside the apartment building and the growing city. All bedrooms also have cut outs at the top of the adjoining wall with the kitchen which allows for noise to pass through. There is a pipe running through the loft and it could be noisy. If you are looking for a quiet stay please visit somo of our other listings.

Check-In 4pm & Check-Out 10am. This Airbnb is very popular, with many back to back bookings. Early check-ins and late check-outs can not be granted in most cases due to our cleaning protocol. Guests only have access into the apartment building during their reservation. Baggage Bellhop is on site for luggage storage if needed for an additional fee. Please plan ahead.
